residualRisk: An approved response is not dispatched to its recipients by the platform: DISPATCH_OUTBOUND has no implementation.
affectedAudience: correspondents who are owed a response
consequence: Approved responses must be sent by hand; nothing in the platform proves they went out.
compensatingControl: Officers send approved responses through the Correspondence Email Desk (IP_SEND_EMAIL, which writes an outbox receipt) or by hand, and record the dispatch on the record.
